mapper.update: UPDATE object_deletion_job SET status='COMPLETED',completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE object_deletion_job SET attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt_at=#{next},last_error=#{error} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
